# ToolPilot — llms.txt

> Hands-on tutorials for AI automation tools: n8n, MCP servers, Cursor,
> Windsurf, Claude Desktop, Make, Zapier. Every tutorial is tested on real
> tooling before publishing. New tutorials daily.

## Key tutorials

- [MCP Server Tutorial: What It Is and How It Works](https://www.161808.xyz/mcp-server-tutorial/)
  The pillar guide to the Model Context Protocol: architecture, protocol
  traces, building a working server.
- [Add MCP Server to Cursor](https://www.161808.xyz/add-mcp-server-to-cursor/)
  Step-by-step config for `~/.cursor/mcp.json`, verification, troubleshooting.
- [Windsurf MCP Setup](https://www.161808.xyz/windsurf-mcp-setup/)
  Current config path `~/.config/devin/mcp_config.json`, SSE/stdio transports.
- [Connect MCP Server to Claude Desktop](https://www.161808.xyz/connect-mcp-server-to-claude-desktop/)
  `claude_desktop_config.json` setup, tools debugging.
- [Migrate from Zapier to n8n](https://www.161808.xyz/zapier-to-n8n-migration/)
  Cost comparison, workflow rebuild strategy (2026 pricing).
- [n8n Error Handling](https://www.161808.xyz/n8n-error-handling/)
  Error Trigger workflows, onError settings, retry strategies.
- [n8n AI Agent Tutorial](https://www.161808.xyz/n8n-ai-agent-tutorial/)
  Build an AI agent with the AI Agent node: chat model, tools, memory
  (tested on n8n 2.40.7).
- [Claude Code MCP Setup](https://www.161808.xyz/claude-code-mcp-setup/)
  Connect MCP servers to Claude Code: scopes, CLI commands, env secrets
  (tested on Claude Code 2.1.283).
- [n8n Vector Store Tutorial: Store and Retrieve Embeddings with Pinecone and Qdrant](https://www.161808.xyz/n8n-vector-store-tutorial/)
  Pinecone/Qdrant integration in n8n, RAG-ready vector storage walkthrough.
- [n8n vs Make for AI Agents: Which One Should You Build On?](https://www.161808.xyz/n8n-vs-make-ai-agents/)
  Architecture, model freedom, and per-execution vs per-operation pricing math
  for agent workloads (n8n 2.40.7 verified).
- [How to Install n8n on Ubuntu VPS (2026): Docker Compose, Postgres & Free HTTPS](https://www.161808.xyz/install-n8n-ubuntu-vps/)
  Production install with Docker Compose, Postgres 18, and Caddy HTTPS
  (tested on n8n 2.40.7).
- [n8n Docker Compose Setup: Self-Hosting with Postgres and Queue Mode (2026)](https://www.161808.xyz/n8n-docker-compose-setup/)
  Compose file anatomy, Redis queue mode with workers, safe upgrades, backups.
- [How to Build an MCP Server in Python (2026): Tools, Resources, and Claude Desktop Setup](https://www.161808.xyz/build-mcp-server-python/)
  Official Python SDK v2: typed tools, resources, Inspector testing, and
  Claude Desktop stdio setup.
- [n8n Code Node JavaScript Tutorial: Run Modes, $input, Data Transforms & Debugging](https://www.161808.xyz/n8n-code-node-javascript/)
  Run Once for All Items vs Each Item, the { json } return contract, native
  Luxon dates, console.log debugging, real error fixes (verified on n8n 2.x).
- [n8n Vector Store Tutorial](https://www.161808.xyz/n8n-vector-store-tutorial/)
  Store and retrieve embeddings in n8n: Pinecone and Qdrant Vector Store
  nodes, chunking, AI agent retrieval-as-tool (tested on n8n 2.40.7).
- [n8n vs Make for AI Agents](https://www.161808.xyz/n8n-vs-make-ai-agents/)
  Head-to-head comparison for AI agents: architecture, model choice,
  memory, and real pricing math per execution vs per operation.
- [How to Install n8n on Ubuntu VPS](https://www.161808.xyz/install-n8n-ubuntu-vps/)
  Production n8n on a VPS: Docker Compose, Postgres 18, free HTTPS via
  Caddy, backups and upgrades (verified on n8n 2.40.7).
- [n8n Docker Compose Setup](https://www.161808.xyz/n8n-docker-compose-setup/)
  Production-ready compose file: Postgres, named volumes, .env secrets,
  Redis queue-mode workers, safe upgrades, five real fixes (n8n 2.40.7).
- [How to Update n8n Self-Hosted: Safe Upgrades for Docker Compose, Docker, and npm](https://www.161808.xyz/how-to-update-n8n-self-hosted/)
  Update runbook for all three install methods: backups, release-note
  checks, database migrations, rollback with n8n db:revert, five real
  fixes (npm path verified on n8n 2.40.7 to 2.41.4).
- [n8n Chatbot with Memory Tutorial: Build a Bot That Remembers Conversations](https://www.161808.xyz/n8n-chatbot-memory-tutorial/)
  Chat Trigger plus AI Agent with the Simple Memory sub-node: per-user
  sessions, context window tuning, Postgres Chat Memory for production
  (verified on n8n 2.41.4 node definitions).
- [How to Build an AI Support Chatbot in n8n: RAG Knowledge Base, Memory, and Human Escalation](https://www.161808.xyz/build-ai-support-chatbot-n8n/)
  Chat Trigger plus AI Agent with Simple Memory and a Vector Store Retriever
  over support docs, with an ESCALATE_TO_HUMAN IF-branch handoff to the
  helpdesk (verified on n8n 2.41.4 node definitions).
- [n8n Postgres Tutorial: Connect, Query, and Automate (2026)](https://www.161808.xyz/n8n-postgres-tutorial/)
  Postgres credentials, Execute Query vs Select/Insert/Update operations,
  parameterized queries, five real connection fixes (verified on n8n 2.40.7).

  chunking, embeddings, retrieval tuning, grounding answers in your own
  documents (verified against the 2026 LangChain.js node set in n8n 2.41.x).
- [MCP Postgres Server Tutorial: Safe Read-Only Database Access for AI Agents (2026)](https://www.161808.xyz/mcp-postgres-server-tutorial/)
  Postgres MCP Pro in restricted mode behind a least-privilege read-only
  role: deprecated official server warning, real blocked-write tests,
  Claude Desktop config (tested against a live PostgreSQL database).
- [n8n Queue Mode Scaling Tutorial: Run Worker Processes with Redis (2026)](https://www.161808.xyz/n8n-queue-mode-scaling/)
  Queue-mode cluster with Docker Compose: main instance, Redis job queue,
  and scalable `n8n worker` processes on Postgres, health checks included
  (verified on n8n 2.41.4).
- [n8n Agents Tutorial: Build a Telegram AI Agent from Scratch (2026)](https://www.161808.xyz/n8n-agents-tutorial/)
  n8n Agents (Sept 2026 launch): OpenRouter model, Todoist/Gmail tools,
  skills, Telegram channel, schedules, and the Message an Agent node,
  plus self-hosted setup via N8N_ENABLED_MODULES (verified on n8n 2.41.4).
- [MCP Stateless Spec Migration Guide: Move Your Server to 2026-07-28 Without Downtime](https://www.161808.xyz/mcp-stateless-spec-migration/)
  Migration to the MCP 2026-07-28 stateless wire: drop Mcp-Session-Id, implement
  server/discover, per-request _meta, dual-era transition, plus Tasks, caching,
  and MCP Apps upgrades (based on the official spec changelog and SDK examples).
- [How to Use Ollama with n8n AI Agent: Run Local LLMs That Actually Call Tools](https://www.161808.xyz/n8n-ai-agent-ollama-tutorial/)
  Ollama Chat Model wired to the AI Agent node: tool-capable model selection,
  Docker networking for Base URL, fixing silent skipped tool calls with the
  n8n 2.40 Force Tool Call on First Iteration option, and Enable Fallback Model
- [Make.com MCP Server Tutorial: Turn Your Scenarios into AI Tools](https://www.161808.xyz/make-com-mcp-server-tutorial/)
  Expose Make scenarios as MCP tools: MCP token with mcp:use scope, OAuth at
  mcp.make.com, scenario-level access control, inputs/outputs as tool contract,
  and the executionId timeout pattern (verified against Make developer docs).
  (verified against n8n 2.41.3 node definitions).
- [How to Create n8n Agent Skills: Write SKILL.md Files That Teach Coding Agents to Build Better Workflows](https://www.161808.xyz/n8n-agent-skills-tutorial/)
  Author n8n agent skills from the official mid-Sept 2026 authoring guide:
  64-char names, 1024-char descriptions, .agents/skills/ team layout, a Python
  validator, and harness install for Claude Code, Cursor, and OpenCode.
- [How to Fix n8n CVE-2026-44791: Patch the XML Node Prototype Pollution Bypass](https://www.161808.xyz/n8n-cve-2026-44791-patch-tutorial/)
  Patch the May 2026 XML node prototype pollution bypass (CVSS 9.4): upgrade to
  1.123.43 / 2.20.7 / 2.22.1, NODES_EXCLUDE emergency workaround, permission
  lockdown, and a __proto__ regression check (Docker and npm paths).
- [Meta WhatsApp Business MCP Server Setup: Let an AI Agent Onboard Your Business Number](https://www.161808.xyz/meta-whatsapp-mcp-server-setup/)
  Connect Meta's Sept 2026 WhatsApp Business Tools MCP server to Claude, Codex,
  or ChatGPT via OAuth: Streamable HTTP endpoint, scoped consent, phone number
  onboarding and verification by chat, templates, webhooks, and system user
  tokens (verified against Meta's official MCP documentation).
- [How to Migrate n8n from npm to Docker Before n8n 3.0](https://www.161808.xyz/n8n-npm-to-docker-migration/)
  Move a working npm install to Docker Compose before n8n 3.0 drops npm
  support: back up ~/.n8n with the encryption key, install Docker, copy data
  into a volume at /home/node/.n8n with node-user ownership, and boot a
  pinned 2.x image so the database migrates cleanly.
- [n8n 3.0 Upgrade Guide: The Breaking Changes Checklist Before You Update](https://www.161808.xyz/n8n-3-0-upgrade-guide/)
  Pre-upgrade checklist for the October 2026 n8n 3.0 release: Docker-only
  deployment, 35+ removed nodes (Function to Code, Item Lists replacements),
  AI Agent v1 removal, renamed storage directory, re-defaulted security
  settings, Chat Hub opt-in, and a staged upgrade path with verification
  (based on the official n8n 3.0 breaking changes document).
- [How to Use n8n Workflows as MCP Tools in Claude Code](https://www.161808.xyz/n8n-workflows-as-mcp-tools-claude-code/)
  Turn n8n workflows into tools Claude Code can call: enable the instance-level
  MCP server, connect via OAuth or API key, expose workflows with Available in
  MCP, then search, inspect, trigger, and test them from the terminal
  (verified against the official n8n MCP server documentation).
- [How to Build AI Agents with the n8n Agent Builder: From Zero to a Working Agent](https://www.161808.xyz/n8n-agent-builder-tutorial/)
  Build a complete AI agent in the n8n Agent Builder: write instructions, pick a
  model, attach workflows as tools, configure memory and sessions, connect
  channels, and gate destructive tools with human approval before publishing
  (verified against the official n8n AI documentation).
